sentences.text: Thomas DeCarlo Callaway -LRB- born May 30 , 1974 , better known by his stage name CeeLo Green -LRB- sometimes rendered as Cee Lo Green -RRB- , is an American singer , rapper , songwriter , record producer , actor , and businessman .	stage name	stage name

Green came to initial prominence as a member of the Southern hip hop group Goodie Mob and later as part of the soul duo Gnarls Barkley , with record producer Danger Mouse .	hip hop	Hip hop music	soul	Soul music	Gnarls Barkley	Gnarls Barkley	Goodie Mob	Goodie Mob	Southern hip hop	Southern hip hop	Danger Mouse	Danger Mouse (musician)
Subsequently he embarked on a solo career , partially spurred by YouTube popularity .	YouTube	YouTube

Internationally , Green is best known for his soul work : his most popular was Gnarls Barkley 's 2006 worldwide hit `` Crazy '' , which reached number 1 in various singles charts worldwide , including the UK .	soul	Soul music	Gnarls Barkley	Gnarls Barkley	Crazy	Crazy (Gnarls Barkley song)
In the United States , `` Crazy '' reached number two on the Billboard Hot 100 .	Crazy	Crazy (Gnarls Barkley song)

Its parent album St. Elsewhere -LRB- 2006 -RRB- , was also a hit , peaked at number 1 on the UK Albums Chart and number 4 on the US Billboard 200 albums chart .	St. Elsewhere	St. Elsewhere (album)	UK Albums Chart	UK Albums Chart
Gnarls Barkley 's second album , The Odd Couple -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , charted at number 12 on the Billboard 200 .	Gnarls Barkley	Gnarls Barkley	The Odd Couple	The Odd Couple (album)
In 2010 , Green took a hiatus from working with Danger Mouse , and released a solo single titled `` Fuck You ! ''	Danger Mouse	Danger Mouse (musician)
The song became a successful single , with the radio-edit version `` Forget You '' , reaching the top spot in the UK and the Netherlands and peaked at number 2 on the US Billboard Hot 100 .

Its parent album , The Lady Killer -LRB- 2010 -RRB- , saw similar success , peaking within the top five of the UK Albums Chart and debuting within the top 10 on the Billboard 200 albums chart , receiving a Gold certification from the BPI in the UK .	UK Albums Chart	UK Albums Chart	The Lady Killer	The Lady Killer (album)
His next two singles , `` It 's OK '' and `` Bright Lights Bigger City '' were also hits in Europe .	Bright Lights Bigger City	Bright Lights Bigger City
From 2011 to 2014 , Green was a judge and coach on American reality television singing competition The Voice , appearing on four of its seasons .	The Voice	The Voice (U.S. TV series)
In 2013 , Green reunited with the rest of Goodie Mob , to release their fifth studio album Age Against the Machine .	Goodie Mob	Goodie Mob	Age Against the Machine	Age Against the Machine
In 2011 he did a concert with Prince in Madison Square Garden .

He worked as a voice actor in the animated feature Hotel Transylvania -LRB- 2012 -RRB- , and also appeared in a few television programs and films -- including his own show , CeeLo Green 's The Good Life , on TBS .	Hotel Transylvania	Hotel Transylvania
